app.title: Show HN: Bolnee-Chat – Self Hosted Chatbot Integration in Your Business Website
app.author: AniketWathore
app.description: A lightweight, self‑hosted chatbot framework that can be embedded into any business website, supporting conversational UI and customizable back‑end logic.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run `npm install`, verify that `npm run dev` starts the dev server
Deploy the demo to a local web page using the provided script tag, send a test query, and assert a valid JSON response
Run the provided unit tests with `npm test` to ensure core chatbot logic works
Measure response latency for a simple echo conversation under load of 100 concurrent requests
